sources.snippet: DM0.5 is Dexmal's next-generation Vision-Language-Action model (VLA) for open-world robot control. It builds on the native embodied modeling approach introduced by DM0, with systematic upgrades for open-ended instructions, long-horizon tasks, dynamic disturbances, and multi-embodiment robot control. RoboDojo unifies efficient simulation evaluation and reproducible real-world testing for generalist robot manipulation, covering 42 simulation tasks, 18 real-world tasks, heterogeneous parallel simulation, RoboDojo-RealEval, XPolicyLab, and a continuously updated leaderboard.
